_doc: Per-jurisdiction transaction taxes. Keyed by ISO country code of the *issuer's primary listing*, not the trading venue (UK FTT applies to LSE-listed UK companies even when traded on a foreign venue). Calculator looks up by `contract.currency` + `primaryExchange` heuristic, with manual overrides for edge cases. Rates current as of `_as_of`.

US.notes: No transaction tax on US equities at federal level. SEC/FINRA fees are in reg_fees.json, not here.

stk_tax.doc: Stamp Duty Reserve Tax (SDRT). 0.5% on UK equity buys ≥ £1,000. AIM-listed shares exempt. Some intra-day market-maker exemptions exist.

GB.notes: Applies to LSE main-market UK companies. Foreign issuers traded on LSE depositary receipts may not be subject.

stk_tax.doc: French FTT. 0.30% on buys of French companies with market cap > €1B (the official 'covered list' updated annually by Direction Générale des Finances Publiques).
Italian FTT. 0.10% on buys of Italian companies with market cap > €500M, on regulated venues (0.20% OTC). Higher rates apply to derivatives.

Swiss federal stamp duty (Umsatzabgabe). 0.075% on Swiss-issued securities, 0.15% on foreign-issued securities, charged on BOTH legs (buy and sell). Levied by the broker if the broker is a Swiss securities dealer.

CH.notes: Only applies if at least one party to the trade is a Swiss securities dealer. IBKR Switzerland (IB Schweiz AG) does levy this on EU/US accounts holding Swiss-listed names.

DE.notes: No active FTT as of 2026 (proposed legislation has been pending for years; not enacted).

stk_tax.doc: Belgian taxe sur les opérations de bourse (TOB). 0.35% on Belgian-resident-investor trades. Rate varies by instrument (0.12% bonds, 1.32% accumulation funds).

NL.notes: No FTT. Watch for political changes — periodically proposed.
